notes.title: Gary's Garden
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39326400/a3eb5155c688f1a0d8830febef1331e5aff6b4cb.png[/img]
Here Comes Niko is already 2 years old!
We'd like to thank everyone who's played the game for their support. We're so honored that so many people have been enjoying the game!

Some of you might have noticed that the game got an update recently, and it's not just any update.
[b]A new area has been added to the game![/b] Help Gary recover his garden from the depths of the ocean.
The area contains one main quest, which changes up the Niko formula slightly. There are also 10 cassettes to find.

To get to the new level, talk to the ghost in Tadpole Inc.!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39326400/3a9384c6cbbf43d46efa2d100256904657f4df65.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39326400/bf4b8a8590112399796f30df06fd8643ab6e4a2f.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39326400/01db1144145c12046fd50254e5ff538a445df2e1.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39326400/5905a012fb9a75730a42f6a424f7a5a57c97184c.jpg[/img]

The update also brings a major boost in performance.

Thank you all again, hope you'll enjoy [i]Gary's Garden[/i].
- Team Frog Vibes

2nd Anniversary video: https://youtu.be/ohHKmAPm7G4?si=vRxlEkvRAzSxsDX3

notes.title: A whole bunch of updates are here!
notes.content:
Hey all!
Some updates are available for you!

Thanks so much for all your patience and working with us on finding and checking these bugs! 


== Gameplay
Fixed volleyball being able to reach extreme speeds.
Fixed volleyball sometimes soft-locking in the air.
Fixed volleyball score being one too low after reaching a high-score.

== Visuals
Fixed Niko's shadow not drawing when the camera is too far away.
Fixed minor rendering issues.

== Achievements
Fixed Hopeless Romantic achievement not triggering after discovering all Handsome Frogs.

== Misc
Fixes Pepper's conversations.
Added Savegame tab in the Options menu, in here you can remove your savegame and restart the game from the beginning.
Added Frame limit option to the Graphics menu, defaults to 60 120. Limits the number of frames the game renders at, reducing strain on high-end graphics cards.
If you have a Nvidia graphics card and you want to use V-sync, please make sure to set the Vertical sync option in the Nvidia Control Panel to Use the 3D application setting or On.

==Home
Softlock fix.
Bottled letter fix.
Fixed reward bubble not appearing after finishing the quest in Home.

== Hairball City
Fixed invisible collider behind the train.
Bottled letter fix.

== Tadpole Inc.
Fixed scene dissapearing when tilting the camera into the volleyball field.
Fixed shadows not drawing on the volleyball field.
Fixed volleyball shadow not drawing in Tadpole Inc.

== Turbine Town
Fixed cassette placement.

== Public Pool
Fixed volleyball shadow not drawing in the water in Public Pool.
"What's my line" vent fix.

== Salmon Creek Forest
Changed Obstacle Volley arena in Salmon Creek Forest.
Ladder fixes.
